title: First-principles study of novel Cs2LuCoH6 and Cs2LuZnH6 double hydride perovskites for hydrogen storage applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29061-29072
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02417C, Paper

Rasmiah S. Almufarij, Malik Shafqat Hayat, R. M. Arif Khalil, Shoug M. Alghamdi, Elsammani Ali Shokralla, Jack Arayro, Mohamed Abdelsabour Fahmy, Mohamed A. Siddig, Ahmed Samir, Arslan Ashfaq
DFT study of Cs2LuCoH6 and Cs2LuZnH6 hydride perovskites shows Co-based compound is stable ferromagnetic semiconductor with good hydrogen storage potential, while Zn-based is metallic and partially unstable, highlighting tunable energy applications.
